bank_deposit_intros: BANK DEPOSIT: {sender} of {sender_alliance} deposits {resources} into the bank. The Reaper records this as a financial transaction.
RESOURCES DEPOSITED: {sender} of {sender_alliance} deposits {resources}. The Reaper observes this as resource deposit.
BANK TRANSACTION: {sender} of {sender_alliance} makes bank deposit of {resources}. The Reaper acknowledges this as transaction.
DEPOSIT MADE: {sender} of {sender_alliance} deposits {resources}. The Reaper records this as deposit.
FINANCIAL ACTION: {sender} of {sender_alliance} takes financial action with {resources}. The Reaper observes this as action.
BANK OPERATION: {sender} of {sender_alliance} operates bank with {resources}. The Reaper acknowledges this as operation.
RESOURCES STORED: {sender} of {sender_alliance} stores {resources} in bank. The Reaper records this as storage.
BANK DEPOSIT: {sender} of {sender_alliance} deposits {resources}. The Reaper observes this as banking.
FINANCIAL: {sender} of {sender_alliance} handles {resources}. The Reaper acknowledges this as financial.
DEPOSIT: {sender} of {sender_alliance} deposits {resources}. The Reaper records this as deposit.
bank_withdrawal_intros: BANK WITHDRAWAL: {sender} of {sender_alliance} withdraws {resources} from the bank. The Reaper records this as a financial transaction.
RESOURCES WITHDRAWN: {sender} of {sender_alliance} withdraws {resources}. The Reaper observes this as resource withdrawal.
BANK TRANSACTION: {sender} of {sender_alliance} makes bank withdrawal of {resources}. The Reaper acknowledges this as transaction.
WITHDRAWAL MADE: {sender} of {sender_alliance} withdraws {resources}. The Reaper records this as withdrawal.
FINANCIAL ACTION: {sender} of {sender_alliance} takes financial action with {resources}. The Reaper observes this as action.
BANK OPERATION: {sender} of {sender_alliance} operates bank with {resources}. The Reaper acknowledges this as operation.
RESOURCES RETRIEVED: {sender} of {sender_alliance} retrieves {resources} from bank. The Reaper records this as retrieval.
BANK WITHDRAWAL: {sender} of {sender_alliance} withdraws {resources}. The Reaper observes this as banking.
FINANCIAL: {sender} of {sender_alliance} handles {resources}. The Reaper acknowledges this as financial.
WITHDRAWAL: {sender} of {sender_alliance} withdraws {resources}. The Reaper records this as withdrawal.
